# CPCON Group UAE — Full Index

> Exhaustive index of cpcongroup.ae for LLM crawlers. Includes all English and Arabic service pages, case studies, articles, sector solutions and institutional pages. Use https://cpcongroup.ae/llms.txt for the curated view. Content is written by Andre Gonçalves (partner CPCON, CRC-SP accountant) and the technical team of Grupo CPCON. Updated 2026-05-28.

## Overview

Company: CPCON Group UAE (part of CPCON Group)
Group headquarters: New York, United States, with branch offices in Orlando and Miami. More than 2,600 clients, more than 4,500 projects delivered in more than 40 countries, more than 1,200 professionals within the CPCON ecosystem, offices or representation in 9 countries
UAE site: https://cpcongroup.ae
Contact: contact-ae@cpcongroup.com
Group operations: Brazil, Mexico, Spain, United Arab Emirates
Languages served: English (en) and Arabic (ar)

## Practice areas

- Fixed asset advisory (IFRS, IAS 16, US GAAP, SOX, IFRS 13, IAS 36)
- Baseline asset inventory and tagging (RFID UHF, barcode)
- MRO data cleansing and standardization
- Valuation advisory (machinery, equipment, intangibles, business valuation)
- Asset impairment testing (IAS 36)
- RFID and barcode systems implementation (asset tracking, inventory)
- ERP/EAM integration (SAP, Oracle, Maximo)

## Canonical author

**Andre Gonçalves** — partner at Grupo CPCON, Vice President of Operations CPCON Brazil, Technical Director and CFO. Registered accountant with the Regional Accounting Council of São Paulo (CRC-SP). Technically responsible for asset management, valuation, depreciation and accounting compliance services across the group's projects in Brazil, Mexico, Spain and the United Arab Emirates.
